tool.name: Focaloop Query
tool.description: run instant follow-up comparisons on saved Focaloop results without re-downloading reads
tool.command: focaloop query --state '$state' #if str($query_type.mode) == "contrast" --mode contrast --contrast '${query_type.factor_name}:${query_type.group_a}:${query_type.group_b}' #if str($query_type.subset).strip() --subset '$query_type.subset' #end if #if str($query_type.hypothesis).strip() --hypothesis '$query_type.hypothesis' #end if #if str($query_type.design).strip() --design '$query_type.design' #end if #else --mode fst --contrast '${query_type.group_column}=${query_type.group_a}:${query_type.group_b}' #if str($query_type.subset).strip() --subset '$query_type.subset' #end if #if str($query_type.hypothesis).strip() --hypothesis '$query_type.hypothesis' #end if #end if --actor 'human' --alpha-budget $validation_options.alpha_budget --n-perm $validation_options.n_perm --out-table '$query_table' --out-verdict '$verdict' --out-report '$query_report' --out-state-archive '$state_out'

param.label: Saved Focaloop state bundle (.focaloop.tar.zst)
param.help: State archive produced by Focaloop ExpressionLoop, Focaloop VariationLoop (multi-group cohort), or a previous Focaloop Query run. GeneLoop state bundles cannot be queried here.

param.label: Comparison type
param.help: Choose differential expression testing for an ExpressionLoop state or population allele-frequency and Fst comparison for a VariationLoop cohort state.
param.option: Population allele-frequency and Fst comparison (VariationLoop state)

param.name: factor_name
param.label: Grouping column in original sample sheet
param.help: Name of the metadata column containing the groups you want to compare (for example, condition or treatment).

validator.message: Use letters, digits, or underscores only

param.name: group_a
param.label: Test group (numerator)
param.help: Group level for the numerator. Positive log2 fold changes mean higher expression in this group.

validator.message: Use letters, digits, underscores, dots, or hyphens only

param.name: group_b
param.label: Reference group (denominator)
param.help: Baseline group level for the denominator.

validator.message: Use letters, digits, underscores, dots, or hyphens only

param.label: Filter samples to a subset before fitting (optional)
param.help: Optional space-separated metadata filters such as plate_id=plate1 or drug=cip timepoint=60m,120m. Automatically drops any constant design covariate inside the subset.

validator.message: Use space-separated column=val1,val2 clauses (letters, digits, underscores, dots, hyphens, commas, equals)

param.label: Specific gene ID to validate on held-out reads (optional)
param.help: Leave blank to validate the top-ranked gene automatically. Results for all genes are always written to the output table.

validator.message: Use letters, digits, underscores, colons, dots, hyphens, or equals signs only

param.label: Override statistical model formula (optional)
param.help: Leave blank to reuse the original model formula, or supply a new formula such as ~batch + condition.

validator.message: Formula must start with ~ followed by valid column names

param.name: group_column
param.label: Grouping column in original sample manifest
param.help: Metadata column defining the sub-cohorts to compare (for example, group, site, or population).

validator.message: Use letters, digits, or underscores only

param.name: group_a
param.label: First group (Group A)
param.help: One group label (or comma-separated labels) for the first population.

validator.message: Use letters, digits, underscores, dots, commas, or hyphens only

param.name: group_b
param.label: Second group (Group B)
param.help: One group label (or comma-separated labels) for the second population.

validator.message: Use letters, digits, underscores, dots, commas, or hyphens only

param.label: Filter samples to a subset (optional)
param.help: Optional space-separated metadata filters such as year=2020 or site=north,east to restrict the Fst comparison to a sub-cohort.

validator.message: Use space-separated column=val1,val2 clauses (letters, digits, underscores, dots, hyphens, commas, equals)

param.label: Specific chromosome or genomic interval to focus on (optional)
param.help: Optional chromosome name (for example, chr1) or interval (chr1:1000-5000) to restrict the comparison. Leave blank for all called sites.

validator.message: Use letters, digits, underscores, colons, dots, hyphens, or equals signs only

param.label: Cumulative significance error budget (alpha)
param.help: Total false-discovery budget shared across repeated follow-up queries on the same saved state bundle. Only used when initializing a fresh ledger.

param.label: Permutation replicates (population Fst p-value)
param.help: Number of random group-label permutations used to estimate the permutation p-value in population Fst comparisons (minimum p-value is 1 / (replicates + 1)).

tool.help:
**What this tool does**
**Focaloop Query** runs new differential expression contrasts or population allele-frequency comparisons directly against a saved `.focaloop.tar.zst` state bundle from **Focaloop ExpressionLoop** or **Focaloop VariationLoop**. It finishes in seconds and downloads zero new sequencing bytes.
-----
**How it works**
1. **Offline recomputation:** Focaloop Query opens your saved state bundle (which already contains per-sample counts, variant calls, and sample group metadata) and disables network access completely while running your requested comparison. 2. **Full-table computation:** For an **ExpressionLoop** state, it refits the differential expression model across every gene for your new group comparison (and optional updated design formula). For a multi-group **VariationLoop** state, it computes per-site alternate allele frequencies, allele-frequency differences, and Hudson Fst across your two selected sub-cohorts plus a permutation p-value. 3. **Holdout check and cumulative error budget:** Running many follow-up tests on the same dataset increases the risk of false positives. Focaloop guards against repeated-testing bias by checking the focal hit against an independent held-out slice of reads (when stored in the bundle) and debiting a small share of a cumulative significance error budget (default `0.05`) recorded in the state bundle's ledger. 4. **Updated state export:** Every query outputs an **Updated state bundle** with the new test recorded in its ledger. Pass that updated bundle into your next **Focaloop Query** call so your cumulative error budget stays properly tracked across a sequence of follow-up questions.
**Compatible vs. incompatible state bundles**
- **Compatible:** State bundles produced by **Focaloop ExpressionLoop**, multi-group cohort runs of **Focaloop VariationLoop**, or earlier **Focaloop Query** runs. - **Not compatible:** State bundles from **Focaloop GeneLoop** (genome annotation telemetry archives) or single-sample **Focaloop VariationLoop** runs that contain only one group label.
-----
**Choosing a comparison type**
| State bundle source | Comparison type to choose | Example comparison | |---|---|---| | **Focaloop ExpressionLoop** | **Differential expression contrast** | Column `condition`, Test group `dose_high`, Reference group `control` | | **Focaloop VariationLoop** (multi-group cohort) | **Population allele-frequency and Fst comparison** | Column `site`, First group `north`, Second group `south` |
-----
**Inputs**
- **Saved Focaloop state bundle:** Select the `.focaloop.tar.zst` archive emitted by **Focaloop ExpressionLoop**, **Focaloop VariationLoop**, or a prior **Focaloop Query** run. - **Grouping column and group labels:** Must match column names and group labels from the sample sheet or manifest used in the original run. In population Fst mode, you may combine multiple labels into one group with commas (for example, `site_a,site_b` vs. `site_c`). - **Specific gene ID or genomic region (optional):** In ExpressionLoop mode, names one specific gene whose discovery and held-out estimates are checked by the validation ledger (the full genome-wide table is still output). In VariationLoop mode, optionally limits the Fst calculation to one chromosome (`chr1`) or interval (`chr1:1000-5000`).
-----
**Key parameters**
- **Filter samples to a subset (`--subset`, optional):** Restricts a large cohort state bundle to a subgroup before running the comparison (for example, `plate_id=plate1` or `drug=cip timepoint=60m,120m`). Any additive design covariate that becomes constant inside the subset is dropped automatically. - **Override statistical model formula (ExpressionLoop only):** Leave blank to keep the model formula from the original run, or enter a new formula (for example, `~batch + condition`) referencing columns from the original sample sheet. - **Cumulative significance error budget (`--alpha-budget`):** Default `0.05`. Controls the total false-positive budget tracked across sequential follow-up queries on the same state bundle. - **Permutation replicates (`--n-perm`):** Default `199`. Increases resolution of the permutation p-value in population Fst queries (with 199 replicates, the smallest possible p-value is `0.005`).
-----
**Outputs**
1. **Query results (`query_table.tsv`):** Full gene-level differential expression table (ExpressionLoop state) or per-variant allele-frequency and Hudson Fst table (VariationLoop state). 2. **Validation summary (`verdict.json`):** Machine-readable summary confirming zero network bytes transferred (`new_bytes: 0`), headline effect size, whether the focal test was confirmed (`confirmed`), and remaining statistical error budget (`wealth_after`). 3. **HTML report:** Self-contained visual summary showing `0 B` transferred, headline statistics, remaining significance budget, and top rows of the results table. 4. **Updated state bundle (`updated_state.focaloop.tar.zst`):** Copy of the input state archive with this query appended to the statistical test ledger. Use this output as the input to your next **Focaloop Query** run.
Key columns in `query_table.tsv` (**VariationLoop** population comparison):
| Column | Meaning | |---|---| | `chrom`, `pos`, `ref`, `alt` | Variant genomic coordinate and alleles | | `af_group_a`, `af_group_b` | Alternate allele frequency in Group A and Group B (0 to 1) | | `delta_af` | Difference in alternate allele frequency (`af_group_a - af_group_b`) | | `hudson_fst` | Per-site Hudson Fst population differentiation statistic (0 = identical allele frequencies, 1 = completely fixed difference) | | `n_group_a`, `n_group_b` | Number of samples in Group A and Group B |
Key columns in `query_table.tsv` (**ExpressionLoop** contrast): match `de_results.tsv` from **Focaloop ExpressionLoop** (`gene_id`, `gene_name`, `baseMean`, `log2FoldChange`, `lfcSE_total`, `pvalue`, `padj`).
-----
**Tips and troubleshooting**
- **Always chain the updated state bundle:** If you run three follow-up comparisons in a row, feed Query 1's **Updated state bundle** into Query 2, and Query 2's into Query 3 so the cumulative error budget accounts for all three tests. - **Group label not found error:** Check exact spelling and capitalization against the original sample sheet or manifest columns. - **Requested gene ID not found:** In ExpressionLoop mode, make sure your optional hypothesis gene ID matches the `gene_id` column in `de_results.tsv` (or leave blank to test the top-ranked gene automatically).
